# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them through [GitHub's private Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/industrial-visual-defect-detection/security/advisories/new). Include a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and potential impact.

The maintainers will acknowledge reports as soon as possible and provide a resolution timeline after confirming the issue. Response times depend on severity and maintainer availability.
